description: Change the company profile of the connected facturo account PERMANENTLY: sender address, UID, Firmenbuch data, default Zahlungsziel, document defaults (Kleinunternehmer, Honorarnote, EPC QR code), standard texts and the numbering start. Only for 'from now on' wishes; a one-off text or VAT mode for a single document goes into preview_invoice/preview_offer instead. Pass ONLY the fields the user asked to change; omitted fields stay, an empty string clears a text. Read the change back and wait for the user's OK first. Bank data and the logo are changed at facturo.at.
